list.question: What makes PRAKRIA different from other digital marketing agencies?
list.answer: We execute a combination of more than 20 years of creative work with data-driven implementation. Contrary to many PPC or SEO companies, we do not treat each digital marketing aspect as an independent one but rather create an integrated strategy that fits your brand.

list.question: How long does it take to see results from SEO?
list.answer: Search engine optimization is a long-term investment whose fruits can be picked mainly in the second half of the first year. Most of the time, the indicators of progress will start to be visible after around 3 to 6 months; however, a steady increase will continue only if your website becomes a recognized authority.

list.question: Is PPC marketing expensive?
list.answer: Not necessarily. If the targeting is accurate and the strategy is well thought out, a pay per click advertising campaign can be one of the cheapest ways to attract the most suitable leads.

list.question: Can social media really help my business?
list.answer: Of course. Social platforms do not only provide exposure to the clients but are also a vehicle for one-to-one dialogue and thus trust-building. As a social media marketing agency, we’ve worked with businesses big and small to create engaged online communities that drive conversions.

list.question: Do I need all digital marketing services at once?
list.answer: Not at all — we customize plans based on your objectives and affordability. Some companies begin their journey with SEO and later decide to venture into performance marketing or content marketing.

ourCore.description: We are not just another packaging design agency. We’re a packaging strategy & design consultancy that partners with you from concept to execution. Here’s what we offer:

list.name: Food Packaging Design
list.title: Food Packaging Design

Food product packaging design from us gives your products the power to grab the attention of customers while still maintaining the quality of the industry. In packaging, we communicate through our products' freshness, flavor, and trust with your innovative designs ranging from snack pouches to beverage bottles.

list.name: Retail Packaging Design
list.title: Retail Packaging Design
list.description: In retail, packaging plays the most important role. Sometimes it is the factor deciding the purchase between browsing further or leaving. Our retail packaging design is perfect for companies as it merges the visuals with the messaging and hence direct consumer attention is the result. Whatever the product be e.g., electronics, lifestyle or FMCG, with our creative packaging design your brand is the first brand that comes out as the customer’s choice in the market.

list.name: Cosmetic & Luxury Packaging Design
list.title: Cosmetic & Luxury Packaging Design

Our cosmetic packaging and luxury packaging design are all about high-end materials, tactile finishes, and minimalist elegance. We are working on making products of the perfume and skincare industry create a feeling of indulgence and reminiscence for the users.

list.name: Custom Packaging Design

list.description: There are several product properties with different needs, for example, size, weight, fragility, perishability, etc. Our custom packaging design services are definitely the perfect solution for brands who want to not only create attractive packaging but also ensure the packaging they use matches their brand identity, product dimensions, and customer target. Structural innovations, package label design, and package logo design are among the services that we do for you to blend the packaging with your brand.

list.name: Sustainable Packaging Design

list.description: People these days are more environmentally conscious and prefer brands with whom they can share their concerns. We are a company specialized in designing sustainable packages that leave behind less waste, make use of recyclable materials, and are aesthetically pleasing and functional at the same time. It is packaging with a mission that is both good for your brand and the planet.
